items.name: pollen-robotics/microduck
items.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE at that commit)
items.notes: Runtime, not the NVIDIA agent workflow. Tree at this SHA has no STL/USD/URDF. It does contain ONNX files: duck-control/models/pickup_detector.onnx (36138 bytes), pet-detect/models/pet_detect.onnx (20201 bytes), and test fixtures. Those ONNX files were not opened; their training data and weights license is unresolved even though they sit in an Apache repo. sounds/ and two PNG files exist (spaces/vetbook/pixel-head.png, pixel-head-gb.png); image/audio licenses not separately stated. docs/robot/simulation.md says duck-sim drives MuJoCo bodies from microduck_rl and does not simulate the servo bus, radio, camera ISP, or NPU.
